dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: None of the plans today are too impractical.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Hello, hello. I am Manua, the assistant to our chief. Hopefully she hasn't caused you any trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong, Amina is very reliable, and she's learned much in the ways of managing the tribe from her grandfather. I have only the fullest of faith in her potential.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: But she is still young, and children are bound to miss some details from time to time, so please bear with her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What plans do you speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Ah, it's Miss Amina's entertainment facilities renovation plan.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Do you find it strange that the chief would bring her plans to me?

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Heh, it's because I'm her assistant.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Amina is very bright and constantly comes up with innovative ideas, like building a water coaster or hosting a kayaking tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: If you ask me, I think she just wants to ride in a water coaster herself, haha. But her ideas have all been very popular with tourists, so we should support her as best as we can.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: See ya. I hope you'll have a good time at the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What plans do you speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Ah, it's Miss Amina's battle preparation and defense facilities renovation plan, as well as her personnel deployment plan.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Do you find it strange that the chief would bring her plans to me?

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Heh, it's because I'm her assistant.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Amina is very bright and always used to come up with all sorts of innovative ideas... albeit mostly entertainment facilities she wanted to try out herself.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: The Abyssal incursions have grown worse lately, and I've noticed that her appetite for fun has decreased considerably. Though we People of the Springs have emerged relatively unscathed, there are always others who need our help.
